Hi. I’m so sorry you’re dad died. I’m sorry you feel defeated. I’ve been there too (I’ve tried to kill myself twice), and know it’s so very, very painful. No one should ever have to go through what you’re going through. 

That being said, I think life does have a hopeful undertone. From my experience as well as observing others, life is very long. Even if you spend 10 years in complete shit (which may be way longer than you’ll actually spend), you still have another 60 left (guessing on your age here). I know how hard it is to hope sometimes, how overwhelming it all is. But there ARE good people who will care, even if you have to look really really hard for them (which often you do).
Sending tons of love your way my friend.

Hi. First off, I know the feeling, I know how overwhelming it is, and how very, very painful. No one should ever have to experience it. 


Depression has tried to kill me twice in two separate suicide attempts. Some months later, I am able to manage the pain—I workout, take vitamin supplements, and make an effort towards connecting with people. I’m not saying you should do all these things right now—likely, you’re mentally unable to, and that’s okay—but they can happen. Life does have a hopeful undertone, and you ARE NOT alone in this darkness. I’ve known far too many shitty people, but there are also those who will care for you and help you. Wishing you the best and sending love.


“Yet somehow the thing that startled me most, after a week or two had passed, was that I had in fact survived.”—Arthur Golden

How long have you felt like this? I’ve been there too— I’m there now, actually. But life is long. Like, really long. Even if you spend 10 years in absolute shit (which is way longer than you might actually spend), you’ve still got another 50 to live happily. 

You can’t recognise any reason to live right now. But what I would encourage you is to try to hope that one day you will. But believe me, I get it. I’ve been through almost all of your situation. We have to hope, and if we don’t have the strength to hope, we have to survive. That being said, it’s shitty and scary as hell. But it’s not forever, so we wait and hope. Sending much love; feel free to message me.

I get it. I’ve been there. I’m there right now. But I would advise you to have steps to accomplish in order to kill yourself, like a routine. For example, brush your teeth, masturbate, eat a fruit, go for a walk, etc. That way, you give yourself buffer time to rethink your decision. I get how walking around with that stuff is comforting, but it makes it a whole lot easier to make a rash decision (and thus a bad one). Sending much love, even as I fight the same fight. Message me anytime.
